name: save_memory
description: Save a piece of information to the user's memory graph in Neptune Analytics. Use this to remember facts, preferences, or context about the user for future conversations.

user_id.description: The user identifier to associate this memory with

content.description: The information to save as a memory

memory_type.description: The type of memory: 'fact', 'preference', or 'context' (optional, default = 'fact')
